1) Week 0 (this week): finalize prompt sets and acceptance criteria w/ your SMEs
2) Week 1: integrate eval harness into your staging cluster; smoke tests + synthetic prompts
3) Week 2: run a 2-hour production canary, monitor QMon signals; if alerts hit thresholds, auto-rollback to prior model variant

Would you be available for a 30-min alignment call Monday 2/8? If yes, I’ll loop in Marissa (eval integration) and Monica (alerts & SLOs).

Subject: Re: Internal: Alpha Health QMon handoff — roles + immediate tasks

Team — proposed thresholds and rollback policy below. These are conservative starting points; we can relax after we gather canary telemetry.

Proposed regression signals (evaluate per 5-minute window):
- Error rate delta: +0.8 percentage points over baseline for 10 consecutive minutes -> warn
- Semantic similarity (embedding cosine) drop: 0.06 average drop across prompt set -> warn
- Perplexity: +12% vs baseline median -> warn
- Critical fail (NLP hallucination detected by classifier): single occurrence -> immediate alert

Rollback policy (canary):
- Stage 1: If two distinct warn-level signals trigger within 20 minutes, escalate to on-call and pause traffic routing (auto-fallback to previous model variant).
- Stage 2: If a critical fail triggers, auto-rollback immediately and page devops@alpha-health.com.
- Post-rollback: automated comparison job that runs the last 100 prompts against the previous variant to create a regression report before re-attempting rollout.

I’ll add these to regression-alerts.md in the Drive folder and draft the short playbook snippet for on-call steps.

—Monica
